spec.title: Grafana Plugins
spec.description: Lists the running versions for this instance.

spec.title: Grafana Build Info
spec.description: Build info for this Grafana instance

spec.expr: count(grafana_build_info{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace"}) by (pod, revision, version, goversion, branch)

spec.title: Plugin Request Tail Latencies By Endpoint (q0.99)
Restarts
spec.description: Number of times the container has restarted since the pod was created

spec.title: OOMKills
spec.description: Number of times Grafana has been oomkilled over the dashboard range

spec.title: Open/Idle DB Connections
spec.description: Lists the _total_ open/idle DB connections from Grafana to the Instance DB server. Note that this is a `sum`.

spec.title: Time waiting for blocked DB connections

spec.legendFormat: Time spent waiting for a connection

spec.title: Closed DB Connections
spec.description: Lists the closed DB connections (per second) from Grafana to the Instance DB server, and the reasons why they were closed.

spec.title: Instance network traffic
spec.description: Shows raw network tx/rx from the instance pod(s). Transmit is positive, Receive is negative, in order to visually separate.
